Begin by noticing where your body touches the chair, bed or floor. Let it hold you.
[pause 57]
[repeat 3]
[in 4] Breathe in
[out 6] And out, slowly
[/repeat]
Today's practice: balanced thoughts.
[pause 56]
Think of an anxious prediction, like "I'll let them down."
[pause 60]
Ask: is this a fact, or a guess?
[pause 60]
What would be a more balanced way to see it?
[pause 60]
Perhaps: "I don't know what will happen, and I can handle it either way."
[pause 60]
Take a slow breath, and notice how you feel now compared with when you started.
[pause 59]
Confidence grows with practice, not perfection.
Let this calm come with you into the rest of your day. When you're ready, slowly return.
[chime]
